requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Syntactic ambiguity regarding 'with the access code' was resolved using the controlled context glossary. The phrase implies two distinct actions (entering card, entering code) rather than a single combined method. Structured as a single functional requirement reflecting the supported interpretation.

structured_requirements.final_statement: The user shall enter the access card and separately enter the access code.
